lines: Kabhi chain se rehne na diya
couplets.en: Peace never stayed with me.

lines: Jab chali sard hawa, maine tujhe yaad kiya
couplets.en: When the cold wind rose, I thought of you.

lines: Iska rona nahin kyun tumne kiya dil barbaad
couplets.en: I could forgive you for breaking my heart.

lines: Iska gham hai ki bahut der mein barbaad kiya
couplets.en: What grieves me is how long you took.

lines: Humko kiske gham ne maara, yeh kahani phir sahi
couplets.en: Whose sorrow undid me can wait for another telling.

lines: Kisne toda dil hamara, yeh kahani phir sahi
couplets.en: Who broke my heart is a story for another time.

lines: Yeh kahani phir sahi
couplets.en: Let that story wait.

lines: Dil ke lutne ka sabab poochho na sabke saamne
couplets.en: Do not ask before them all how I lost my heart.

lines: Yeh kahani phir sahi
couplets.en: Let that story wait.

lines: Gham ne maara, yeh kahani phir sahi
couplets.en: Sorrow undid me, but the story can wait.

lines: Nafraton ke teer kha kar doston ke shahr mein
couplets.en: In the city of friends, I bore the arrows of hatred.

lines: Humne kis kis ko pukara
couplets.en: How many names I called.

lines: Kya bataayen pyaar ki baazi wafa ki raah mein
couplets.en: What can I say of the wager love asks of the faithful?
